description: For persons other than Individuals, HUF, Company and Person filing Form ITR-7. Applicable to Firms, LLPs, AOP, BOI, Artificial Juridical Persons.

fields.name: PAN & General Information
fields.description: Entity PAN, legal status (e.g., Firm, LLP, Trust), business nature, and address.

fields.name: Partners/Members Detail
fields.description: Names, PANs, and profit-sharing ratios of partners in a firm or members in an AOP/BOI.

fields.name: Balance Sheet (Part A-BS)
fields.description: Assets, liabilities, capital structure, and reserves as of 31st March.

fields.name: Manufacturing/Trading/P&L Account (Part A-P&L)
fields.description: Detailed income and expenditure statement, closing stock, sales, and corresponding direct/indirect expenses.

fields.name: Computation of Business Income (Schedule BP)
fields.description: Additions and deductions to arrive at taxable business profits (e.g., adjusting inadmissible expenses).

fields.name: Other Income (Schedules HP, CG, OS)
fields.description: Income from let-out properties, capital gains on asset sales, or other sources like interest.

fields.name: Depreciation Schedule (DPM/DOA)
fields.description: Claiming depreciation based on income tax slab rates on company assets.

fields.name: Tax Deducted/Collected at Source (Schedule TDS/TCS)
fields.description: Details of TDS certificates (Form 16A/27D) received from deductors.

fields.name: Computation of AMT (Schedule AMT)
fields.description: Alternate Minimum Tax liability applicable if standard tax is lower than 18.5% of adjusted total income.

fields.name: Verification (Part B-TTI)
fields.description: Final tax liability calculation, determining tax payable or refund, and signature by the authorized partner/person.
